Chases($x, BaldEagle, True) >>> Round($x, True) ::: If something chases the bald eagle then it is round.

Sees($x, BaldEagle, True) && Chases($x, Cat, True) >>> Sees(BaldEagle, Cat, True) ::: If something sees the bald eagle and it chases the cat then the bald eagle sees the cat.

Query:
Sees(Cat, Lion, True) ::: The cat sees the lion.
